A '''hotbox''' was a container aboard a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that contained general emergency equipment such as a [[Environment suit/Legends|vacsuit]], [[Fire extinguisher/Legends|fire suppressant cylinders]], [[Breath mask/Legends|breath masks]], and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]].
